title: Evaluating Antiviral Effects of FDA-Approved Drugs Against Dengue Virus
author: Palacios-Rápalo, Hernández-Castillo, et al.
materials:
1.Acquire all critical reagents mentioned in the key resources table.2.Acquire cell lines to be used in this protocol and prepare enough frozen stocks.3.Acquire dengue virus (DENV) stock to be used in this protocol.4.Prepare media using recipes described in this protocol.
CRITICAL: All procedures must be performed in a BSL-2 certified laboratory equipped with a biosafety cabinet using standard aseptic techniques. Cultures are grown and maintained in a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.

steps.title: Prepare research materials and safety
steps.instruction: Acquire all critical reagents listed in the key resources table, obtain Huh7 cell line stocks, acquire the DENV stock, and prepare media as described. Perform all work in a BSL‑2 laboratory using a biosafety cabinet and standard aseptic technique. Grow cultures in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Culture Huh7 cells to confluency
steps.instruction: Plate Huh7 cells in 100 mm dishes with complete DMEM medium and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until they reach 80 %–100 % confluency (required for downstream steps).

steps.title: Harvest Huh7 cells for experiments
steps.instruction: Detach and collect cells from 100 mm plates for downstream use.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant.
Wash cells with 5 mL cold 1X PBS.
Add 4 mL 0.1 % trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 1–3 min at 25 °C until cells round (≈1 × 10⁷ cells per plate).
Add 5 mL complete DMEM to inactivate trypsin‑EDTA; pipette to a homogeneous suspension and transfer to conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 1,900 × g for 7 min at 25 °C; discard supernatant, keep pellet.
Resuspend pellet in 5 mL complete DMEM.
Wash once with 1X PBS, then repeat the 1,900 × g, 7 min, 25 °C centrifugation.
Dilute the harvested cells to the desired concentration with complete DMEM as needed.

steps.title: Seed cells for flow cytometry assay
steps.instruction: Plate the harvested Huh7 cells in 12‑well plates so that they reach 70 %–80 % confluency at the time of infection and drug treatment.

steps.title: Harvest and fix cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Collect, fix, and store cells prior to antibody labeling.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant from the 12‑well plate.
Wash cells with 1 mL cold 1X PBS.
Add 500 µL 0.1 % trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 1–3 min at room temperature until rounded.
Optionally store the collected supernatant at –80 °C for plaque assays.
Immediately remove trypsin‑EDTA.
Add 1 mL complete DMEM to inactivate trypsin‑EDTA; pipette to a homogeneous suspension and transfer to a 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 50 × g for 8 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 200 µL 1X PBS.
Add 600 µL cold 4 % paraformaldehyde; incubate 30 min with constant agitation at room temperature.
Add 200 µL 1X PBS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 8 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL 1X PBS and repeat the 500 × g, 8 min, 4 °C spin.
Discard supernatant and resuspend in 300 µL 1X PBS.
Pause point: store cells in 1X PBS at 4 °C (max 1–2 weeks). Do NOT store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Label cells with primary and secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Permeabilize, stain with primary anti‑prM/E (2H2) antibody, then with Alexa‑488 secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL 1X PBS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 8 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Add 500 µL permeabilizing solution, resuspend, and incubate 30 min with constant agitation at room temperature.
Add 1 mL 1X PBS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 8 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Add 50 µL 2H2 antibody diluted 1:50 in permeabilizing solution; incubate at 4 °C with constant agitation.
Add 1 mL 1X PBS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 8 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Add 50 µL Alexa 488 secondary antibody diluted 1:750 in permeabilizing solution; incubate 2 h at 25 °C with constant agitation, protected from light.
Add 1 mL 1X PBS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 8 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 300 µL 1X PBS.
Pause point: cells can be stored at 4 °C for up to 1–2 weeks.

steps.title: Acquire data on flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Run the labeled samples on a BD LSR Fortessa (or equivalent) using a threshold of 15,000 and the following voltages: FSC 240 V, SSC 260 V, Alexa 488 375 V, Pacific Blue 320 V.

steps.title: Analyze flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Process the files with FlowJo v10: gate total population (SSC‑A vs FSC‑A) and single cells (FSC‑H vs FSC‑A), and analyze 10,000 events per sample.

description: This protocol focuses on two sections: 1) the confocal immunofluorescence and flow cytometry approach to measure the antiviral effect of nuclear import inhibitors FDA-approved drugs such as Ivermectin (IVM) or Atorvastatin (ATV) and 2) mice survival assays to measure the antiviral efficacy of these drugs (Figure 1).Figure 1The starting materials are Huh7 cells (in vitro assays) and AG19 mice (in vivo assays)Section 1: In vitro measurement of the molecular antiviral effect of nuclear import inhibitor drugs, IIF to evaluate nuclear import during treatment, and flow cytometry to measure the antiviral effect of nuclear import inhibitor drugs. Section 2: Survival assay to measure the antiviral efficacy of nuclear import inhibitor drugs in DENV-infected AG129 mice and obtaining tissue sections to analyze the nuclear localization of DENV proteins.
